verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Gemini in BigQuery generates and suggests SQL or Python and explains existing SQL queries (docs-5). It also uses natural language to find, join and query table assets (docs-39) and to generate and complete code (docs-66), with conversational analytics and data canvas built into the product (docs-3, docs-71, docs-4). Data insights generates queries from table metadata (docs-72), which shows the assistant works against your own schemas. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the assistant fixes or debugs broken SQL, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's quality.
